mapper.insert: insert into `team_task`(team_id, assignee_type, name, content, type, start_time, end_time, reward, creator_id, overall_status, is_deleted) values(#{teamId}, #{assigneeType}, #{name}, #{content}, #{type}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{reward}, #{creatorId}, 'ongoing', 0)
mapper.select: select id, team_id, assignee_type, name, content, type, start_time, end_time, reward, creator_id, overall_status, is_deleted, create_time from `team_task` where id = #{id}

select tt.id, tt.team_id, tt.assignee_type, tt.name, tt.content, tt.type, tt.start_time, tt.end_time, tt.reward, tt.creator_id, tt.overall_status, tt.create_time, (select count(*) from `team_member` m where m.team_id = tt.team_id and m.status = 'approved') as member_count, (select count(*) from `team_task_completion` c where c.task_id = tt.id) as completed_count, (select count(*) from `team_task_completion` c where c.task_id = tt.id and c.user_id = #{userId}) as my_completed from `team_task` tt where tt.team_id = #{teamId} and tt.is_deleted = 0 order by tt.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into `team_task_completion`(task_id, user_id, complete_time) values(#{taskId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: select count(*) from `team_task_completion` where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId}
select c.user_id, c.complete_time, u.nickname, u.username from `team_task_completion` c left join `user` u on u.id = c.user_id where c.task_id = #{taskId} order by c.complete_time asc

select tt.id, tt.team_id, tt.assignee_type, tt.name, tt.content, tt.type, tt.start_time, tt.end_time, tt.reward, tt.creator_id, tt.overall_status, tt.create_time, t.name as team_name, (select count(*) from `team_task_completion` c where c.task_id = tt.id and c.user_id = #{userId}) as my_completed, (select c.complete_time from `team_task_completion` c where c.task_id = tt.id and c.user_id = #{userId} limit 1) as my_complete_time from `team_task` tt join `team` t on t.id = tt.team_id and t.status = 'normal' where tt.is_deleted = 0 and (tt.assignee_type = 'all' or exists ( select 1 from `team_task_assignee` a where a.task_id = tt.id and a.user_id = #{userId})) order by tt.create_time desc
